task: Configure the daily Workers AI admission ceiling at 10,000 neurons.
nonGoals: No deployment, live inference, reservation reset, usage evidence change, CPU or non-AI allowance change, or frontend changes.

outcomes.description: Read the configured daily Workers AI ceiling of 10,000 and deny admissions above it.
outcomes.evidence: Ledger and Granite runtime boundary regressions.

outcomes.description: Apply the new ceiling to existing default cycle records without resetting settled usage or outstanding holds.
outcomes.evidence: Same-cycle upgrade, rollover, atomic admission and legacy cycle tests.

process.description: Commit this follow-up plan separately and keep the change on the Granite PR.
process.evidence: Plan and implementation commits, source-bound evidence and independent review.

styleEfficiency.description: Use one runtime config source and keep other meter and CPU settings stable.

exitTest.reason: Changes the account ceiling without altering job checkpoints, resumption or agent portability. Tests exercise already persisted usage and holds.

context: The user raised the Workers AI limit to the included daily allocation and requested a config file. The Granite provider remains opt-in and production is out of scope.
